instruction: What is the title of the most-played song in my Spotify album library.
notes: Pure information-retrieval task: no database changes, goal is only the answer. The album library (paginated) and the per-song show_song loop are collapsed into a single representative song object `most-played-song`; at runtime the executor pages through show_album_library, collects all song_ids, calls show_song on each, and binds `most-played-song`/`most-played-song-title` to the song with the highest play_count. show_album_library carries the song as a non-API record parameter so it can assert membership/known-id; show_song asserts the retrieved play count and title; complete_task passes the title as `answer` and is forced last via (not (task-completed)) on every other action. page_index is omitted from the PDDL (handled by the executor).
